subject: Trial onramp: access checklist, owners, and timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@skyward.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial onramp: access checklist, owners, and timeline

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get Skyward's POC started next week.

Goal & success criteria (from our discussion)
- Run 2 representative pipelines (batch and low-latency inference) against your internal dataset and measure latency and per-token cost.
- Qualitative: model should match or exceed current system on F1 for entity extraction on the 3 sample flows you shared.
- Operational: stable 95th percentile latency under 220ms for interactive tests, and sustained throughput of 40 req/s for batch.

Trial scope and timeline
- Week 0 (this week): credentials + SSO invites + IP allowlist.
- Week 1: ingest sample dataset, run baseline tests with our small GPU profile.
- Week 2: scale to larger batch runs, validate KV caching behavior, and run cost/latency comparisons.

Ownership (who does what)
- Redwood: Jonas (SE) will provision trial keys, help with SSO config, and own the runbook.
- Skyward: Oliver (engineering lead) will own dataset access and coordinate with your infra/security (Nadia) on IP allowlist and SSO test users.
- Hannah (me): overall program owner — weekly sync and escalation path.

Immediate asks for your team
1) Provide the IP range(s) to allowlist for your SSO provider (we'll give ours too).
2) Confirm the users you want invited via SSO (email domains).
3) OK to issue a single temporary API key for the initial week (we recommend scoped key + 100k token quota)?

Attachments: I attached a short POC checklist (poc-checklist.xlsx) and a one-page SSO config summary (sso-config-guide.pdf).

If that all looks good I'll queue the SSO invites and Jonas will post the temp key in a secure channel once your infra confirms the allowlist. Proposed check-in: Wed 21 Jul, 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@skyward.ai>

Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial onramp: access checklist, owners, and timeline

Thanks, Hannah — this is perfect and aligns with our notes. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Confirmed success criteria look good to us. The entity extraction F1 target we'll treat as a gating metric; we'll share the evaluation script by EOD Monday.
- For SSO, our identity team uses auth.skyward.ai as the IdP domain. Please send SAML metadata or an invite link for Okta/SAML.
- IP ranges to allowlist (outbound from Redwood): we'll ask our infra to confirm but can you provide the egress IP blocks you use for hosted trials? We prefer allowlisting by CIDR.

On the API key: yes, a scoped temporary key with a conservative quota sounds right. We'll also need a note on rate limiting for the interactive tests so our client app can backoff appropriately.

I copied Nadia (security) here — she'll coordinate the allowlist and our security checklist. Nadia: our internal contact is oliver@skyward.ai for the trial; please coordinate on times for a short handoff call with Jonas.

We'll aim for the Wed 21 Jul sync.

—Oliver
CTO, Skyward AI
